shape_hint: A round slotted lock nut for rolling bearings: a short cylinder (outer diameter d2, thin width h) with a fine internal thread, four evenly spaced rectangular slots (width b, depth t) cut across one face for a hook/impact wrench and for the tab of a lock washer, and a short collar/relief of diameter d3 on the bearing-side face.

notes: KM designation = ascending index: KM0 M10x0.75, KM1 M12x1, KM2 M15x1, KM3 M17x1, KM4 M20x1, KM5 M25x1.5 (dropped), KM6 M30x1.5, ... KM27 M135x2 (as printed by schrauben-lexikon and digipich). Thread sizes are fine pitch: do NOT read 'M30' as coarse M30. Matching lock washers are MB<n> with the same index (fasten.it/schrauben-lexikon list them). ISO 2982-2:2013, KS B 2004 and JIS AN nuts not verified; fasten.it marks DIN 981 as 'Withdrawn' (hint says 2009-06 current) - maintainer should confirm which standard the catalog cites. Inch bearing locknuts are a separate family (ilocknut).

verification.checks_done: Re-fetched 3 listed URLs + fasteners.eu DIN 981 live, HTTP 200. 26 rows x 6 value cols (P,d2,d3,h,b,t): fasten.it 156/156 ok (2009 table; 1993 table also equal), lexikon 130/130 ok (pitch read from designation M..x..), digipich 156/156 ok, fasteners.eu 130/130 ok. 0 mismatches; every cell exactly 3 clusters. KM index mapping (thread->KM n) identical in lexikon, digipich and fasteners.eu for all 26 rows; fasten.it MB n equals KM n index. Dropped rows KM5/KM17 re-confirmed: KM5 thread is M25 in fasten.it+lexikon but M24 in FE (typo) -> label has 2 clusters only; KM17 h=16 in fasten.it+FE vs 15 lexikon -> 2 clusters only. Physical: d3<d2, b<d3, t<h, all monotone.
problems: Exactly 3 clusters on every cell, and one of them (digipich) is a verbatim copy of fasteners.eu - zero margin; any later disagreement kills a cell.

Row labels are thread designations Mx

(consistent in all sources). The KM numbers (KM0..KM27) are printed only by lexikon and the FE cluster (2 clusters; fasten.it only gives lock-washer MB numbers) -> do NOT use KM numbers as the key; keep thread labels. Sequence has gaps (KM5 M25x1.5, KM17 M85x2 absent).

Labels M120x2 and M130x2 also exist in the light KML series (d2 145/155, d3 135/145) in fasten.it and FE; record correctly uses heavy KM values (d2 155/165) but the bare label is ambiguous across series.
Do not read M30x1.5 etc. as coarse M30 (all rows fine pitch) - ok as labelled.
Role of b (slot width), t (slot depth), d3 (bearing-side diameter, max) comes from DIN 981 symbols; sources print only symbols/tolerances (h13 -> nominal=max), no verbal definition. Low risk.
fasten.it flags DIN 981 'Withdrawn' (replaced by ISO 2982-2); catalog should say which standard it cites.
